items.title: Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1969-12-14
items.q: The interviewee (Johnny Wiggs) is not present in the transcript; the mention of Jack Lane is made by the Interviewer (Jack Lane's daughter) and responded to by Dick Allen. The interviewee is merely the subject of the call but does not speak about his relationship with Jack Lane.
